scene.scope: relative scene-linear P3 approximation; no unique capture-ISP inverse
scene.area_constraint: Nonnegative RGB cell scaling after bilinear log-gain; cell boundaries may gain discontinuities
scene.mask_scope: conservative information-loss/sensitivity flags, not proof of a unique scene inverse

inverse_subset.solver_scope: conditional numerical experiment; failure is not evidence of noninvertibility
inverse_subset.bound: Input restricted to [0,1.25]: conservative absolute RGB error bound 1.25; no finite EV bound at zero or outside a bounded input domain.

gain_application_order.scope: Controlled application/resampling variants; no RAW oracle

thumbnail_information_bounds.bounds_scope: Conditional decoded-RGB +/-halfLSB sensitivity. Lossy HEVC error is not bounded by halfLSB. Unbounded pre-clamp side is represented by +/-inf in NPZ. Not a complete scene inverse.
thumbnail_information_bounds.near_zero_EV_bound: unbounded if the admissible interval contains zero
thumbnail_information_bounds.scene_gtc_only_upper_bound: unbounded at GTC upper endpoint absent an explicit maximum-scene prior; a separate valid thumbnail may supply additional information
